title: Previously certified Environmental Impact Report No. ENV-2017-438-EIR (State Clearinghouse No. 2018051050), Erratum, First Addendum, second Addendum,…
text:
[Council File 21-0784-S1; CD 14]
Previously certified Environmental Impact Report No. ENV-2017-438-EIR (State Clearinghouse No. 2018051050), Erratum, First Addendum, second Addendum, pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines Sections 15162 and 15164, and related CEQA findings; report from the Los Angeles City Planning Commission; and draft Ordinance relative to a Vesting Zone Change to amend the Qualified “Q” Conditions of Zone Change Ordinance No. 187209; for a new mixed-use, two-tower development with 474 live/work units (including 77 affordable units) and 2,034 square feet of ground floor commercial space, totaling 512,990 square feet of floor area on a 2.2 acre site, Building 1 would provide 324 units and 1,066 square feet of commercial space within a 30-story building, and Building 2 would provide 150 units and 968 square feet of commercial space within a 20-story building, five existing buildings, comprising 56,686 square feet of office, restaurant, warehouse, and six live/work units, would remain, and at completion, the project would result in a total of 480 live/work units and 36,865 square feet of commercial space, for a total of 569,676 square feet of floor area; for the property located at 2117 – 2147 East Violet Street and 2118 – 2142 East 7th Place, subject to Conditions of Approval; and adoption of project findings.
Applicant: Mark Spector, ONNI Capital, LLC
Representative: Matt Dzurec, Armbruster Goldsmith & Delvac, LLP
Case No. CPC-2025-2329-VZC-PR-HCA
Environmental No. ENV-2017-438-EIR-ADD2
Related Cases Nos. VTT-74890-CN; VTT-74890-CN-M1; CPC-2017-437-GPAJ-ZVC-HD-VCU-MCUP-SPR
